title: Cornering Catwoman (ORIGINAL)

You're having none of her nonsense and press your gun on her chin… only to find that your other "gun" in your pocket is pressed stiffly against her ass, goddamn that latex suit!. This naughty girl seems very willing to take it further with you… with *BOTH* your irons… Fuck! You know this is a dangerous game to play with Catwoman, but you also know it might just be a risk worth taking for a moment with such an infamous character. You decide to take the chance, since you're the one packing heat… you're the one in control… or are you?
author: Mistress Shibby
